test_title: PYST 28: SSC CGL 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On: 24 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: Pond water and sea water are considered as fresh water.
Rivers and sea water are considered as fresh water.
Rivers, creeks, lakes, ponds, and streams are all freshwater habitats.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Rivers, creeks, lakes, ponds, and streams are all freshwater habitats.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• Freshwater habitats include lakes, ponds, rivers, streams, and creeks. These are environments with water that contains minimal amounts of dissolved salts.

• Freshwater habitats are crucial for a wide variety of organisms, including fish, amphibians, plants, and invertebrates.

• These habitats provide essential resources such as drinking water, food, and shelter for many species.

• Freshwater ecosystems are vital for human needs as well, providing water for drinking, agriculture, sanitation, and industrial processes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Freshwater**

• Freshwater is defined as water with low concentrations of dissolved salts, typically less than 1%.

• It is found in rivers, lakes, streams, ponds, and groundwater.

• Freshwater is essential for most terrestrial life forms and is a critical resource for human survival.

• **Freshwater Habitats**

• These habitats include a variety of environments such as rivers, lakes, streams, ponds, and wetlands.

• Freshwater habitats support a diverse range of organisms, including fish, amphibians, reptiles, mammals, birds, and invertebrates.

• These ecosystems are dynamic and can vary significantly in their physical, chemical, and biological characteristics.

• **Importance of Freshwater Ecosystems**

• Freshwater ecosystems are crucial for maintaining biodiversity and ecological balance.

• They provide essential services such as water purification, flood regulation, and habitat for numerous species.

• Freshwater resources are used for drinking, irrigation, industry, recreation, and transportation.

• Conservation of freshwater habitats is vital for ensuring a sustainable supply of clean water for future generations.

• **Threats to Freshwater Ecosystems**

• Pollution from agricultural runoff, industrial discharges, and urbanization can degrade water quality and harm aquatic life.

• Over-extraction of water for irrigation, industry, and domestic use can deplete freshwater resources.

• Climate change can alter precipitation patterns, leading to changes in water availability and the health of freshwater ecosystems.

• Invasive species can disrupt native ecosystems and reduce biodiversity.
